notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
An opponent cannot block and kill Phantom Steed.
easyPrerequisites: Vampire Charmseeker is exiled by Phantom Steed.
description:
Declare Phantom Steed and a Rogue as attackers. Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker that's tapped and attacking.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand if its in your graveyard.
Deal combat damage using the Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, creating a number of 1/1 Faerie Rogue creature tokens and causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Repeat each turn
